branch_SLOT_name.description: Branch SLOT | Unique branch name (portable identifier); also names its registered model

branch_SLOT_task.description: Branch SLOT | What will the model predict? regression = a number; classification = a category

branch_SLOT_target_column.description: Branch SLOT | Column containing the known answer during training, e.g. churn or claim_amount

branch_SLOT_input_columns.description: Branch SLOT | Columns the model learns from, e.g. income, age, balance. Separate names with commas; exclude record keys and the answer column

branch_SLOT_preprocessing_recipe.description: Branch SLOT | Named recipe from features/preprocessing.py: default, none, imputer_only, frequency_only or combined; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_SLOT_pre_split_recipe.description: Branch SLOT | Named recipe from features/pre_split.py: default, none or complete_inputs; adapt recipe columns to this branch

branch_SLOT_cv_enabled.description: Branch SLOT | Use several training-only folds to score search candidates? No duplicate post-search CV report. With CV off, search uses a training-only validation split. Final test rows stay separate. Defaults: 5-fold K-fold, shuffle enabled, seed 42; the following questions select the fold policy before the data window. Model competition always enables the shared CV policy.

branch_SLOT_cv_folds.description: Branch SLOT | How many CV splits? 5 means five evaluations; more splits take longer (2-20)

branch_SLOT_cv_type.description: Branch SLOT | Fold method: k_fold, stratified_k_fold, time_series_split, shuffle_split, group_k_fold, stratified_group_k_fold, or nested_cv. Nested CV repeats an independent inner search in every outer training fold, then runs a separate final search Temporal CV automatically selects a chronological final holdout; its clock/window questions follow.

branch_SLOT_cv_inner_folds.description: Branch SLOT | Inner search folds for nested CV (2-20). Leave blank for the Core default. The strategy budget applies to every outer-fold search and the final search.

branch_SLOT_cv_nested_type.description: Branch SLOT | Policy at both nested levels; auto selects stratified classification or regression K-fold. Temporal requires a temporal final holdout and event_column.

branch_SLOT_cv_group_column.description: Branch SLOT | Group identity column, excluded from features. Final holdout isolates whole groups; disable holdout stratify.

branch_SLOT_cv_gap.description: Branch SLOT | Rows excluded before each temporal validation window at both nested levels.

branch_SLOT_cv_test_size.description: Branch SLOT | Temporal validation rows per fold; null uses the Core default.

branch_SLOT_cv_max_train_size.description: Branch SLOT | Temporal training rows; null expands, an integer creates a rolling window.

branch_SLOT_cv_shuffle.description: Branch SLOT | Shuffle rows for CV? Use false for time_series_split, true for shuffle_split

branch_SLOT_cv_random_state.description: Branch SLOT | Seed for repeatable CV splits. Keep 42 unless you want different splits

branch_SLOT_split_strategy.description: Branch SLOT | How to reserve test rows? random = random rows; temporal = newer rows for testing and older rows for training. Default source: full snapshot for random, rolling calendar for temporal. Override training_window_mode in an init file.

branch_SLOT_test_size.description: Branch SLOT | Share of rows reserved for final testing: 0.2 means 20% test and 80% training

branch_SLOT_random_state.description: Branch SLOT | Seed for repeatable random splitting. Keep 42 unless you want a different split

branch_SLOT_stratify.description: Branch SLOT | Keep similar proportions of each target class in training and test rows?

branch_SLOT_training_window_mode.description: Branch SLOT | Which source rows to use? full_snapshot = all; fixed_window = dates you enter; rolling_calendar = recent complete months; rolling_days = last N elapsed UTC days; auto = all for random, recent months for temporal

branch_SLOT_window_timezone.description: Branch SLOT | Timezone defining calendar month boundaries, e.g. Europe/Copenhagen. This controls selected data, not when the job runs

branch_SLOT_monthly_lookback_months.description: Branch SLOT | Total complete past months to read, including the final holdout. Example: 4 months with a 2-month holdout leaves 2 months for training

branch_SLOT_holdout_months.description: Branch SLOT | How many final complete months to hold out for testing? Enter 1 to total lookback minus 1; example: 2

branch_SLOT_event_column.description: Branch SLOT | Column containing when each record was observed, e.g. observation_date; used to select older/newer data

branch_SLOT_event_time_kind.description: Branch SLOT | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_SLOT_event_text_kind.description: Branch SLOT | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_SLOT_event_time_format.description: Branch SLOT | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_SLOT_event_time_timezone.description: Branch SLOT | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_SLOT_event_date_only.description: Branch SLOT | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_SLOT_start.description: Branch SLOT | Earliest observation to include, e.g. 2026-06-01T00:00:00+02:00. Required for fixed_window; rolling_calendar calculates it for every run

branch_SLOT_holdout_start.description: Branch SLOT | Observations from this time onward are test rows, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00+02:00. Older selected rows train the model; rolling runs calculate it

branch_SLOT_cutoff.description: Branch SLOT | Stop before this observation time, e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00+02:00. This is a data boundary, not the job date; rolling runs calculate it

branch_SLOT_filter_unavailable_results.description: Branch SLOT | Do answers become known later? true = exclude rows whose answer was not yet available at the chosen time; false = use supplied answers

branch_SLOT_result_availability_lag_hour.description: Branch SLOT | When result_cutoff is blank, subtract this many hours from run start. Enter 0 to 87600; example: 48 excludes results available in the last two days. An explicit result_cutoff overrides this lag for every run

branch_SLOT_result_available_at_column.description: Branch SLOT | Column recording when each answer became known, e.g. claim_confirmed_at. This is a column name, not a date you enter

branch_SLOT_result_time_kind.description: Branch SLOT | How is this column stored? timestamp = database timestamp representing an instant; local_timestamp = database date/time without timezone; date = day only; text = a string. Choose yourself; setup does not inspect the table

branch_SLOT_result_text_kind.description: Branch SLOT | What does the date text contain? offset_datetime = date/time with Z or +02:00; local_datetime = date/time without an offset; date = only a day, e.g. 2026-08-10

branch_SLOT_result_time_format.description: Branch SLOT | How should this date text be read? Example: 10/08/2026 14:30 -> %d/%m/%Y %H:%M; 2026-08-10 -> %Y-%m-%d; 2026-08-10T14:30:00+02:00 -> %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z

branch_SLOT_result_time_timezone.description: Branch SLOT | Which location does this clock/date belong to? Enter e.g. Europe/Copenhagen or UTC

branch_SLOT_result_date_only.description: Branch SLOT | This column has a day but no time. May we treat it as the start of that day? midnight = yes, 00:00 in your chosen timezone; reject = stop if such a value is encountered

branch_SLOT_result_cutoff.description: Branch SLOT | Use answers known by this time, INCLUDING this instant, e.g. 2026-09-15T00:00:00+02:00. An explicit cutoff applies to every run; blank derives run start minus result_availability_lag_hours

branch_SLOT_max_rows.description: Branch SLOT | Maximum rows transferred into Python memory per read; exceeding this stops the run. This does not randomly sample rows

branch_SLOT_max_input_mb.description: Branch SLOT | Maximum input data size transferred into Python memory, in MiB (64 = 64 MiB). Model training can use more RAM

branch_SLOT_training_sample_rows.description: Branch SLOT | Optional sample: enter 10000 to select up to 10000 eligible rows BEFORE train/test splitting. null = no sampling. Prediction rows are never sampled

branch_SLOT_training_sample_seed.description: Branch SLOT | Seed for choosing the same sample from the same table snapshot. Keep 42 unless you want another sample

branch_SLOT_regression_model.description: Branch SLOT | Choose a regression model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_SLOT_classification_model.description: Branch SLOT | Choose a classification model. It starts with its default settings; README explains how to change them

branch_SLOT_model_params.description: Branch SLOT | Optional JSON object of fixed model parameters. For voting/stacking, include base_estimators and any base_estimator_params or final_estimator to define the ensemble. Other models can set this in an init file or generated config

branch_SLOT_search_strategy.description: Branch SLOT | Choose grid, random, halving_grid, halving_random, or optional Optuna. Core supplies a model-appropriate default search space; grid strategies evaluate its full Cartesian product

branch_SLOT_search_settings.description: Branch SLOT | Use Core defaults for this strategy, or customize its controls below

branch_SLOT_search_max_candidates.description: Branch SLOT | Maximum full-grid combinations to admit (1-10000). Grid and halving_grid run every combination, so preflight rejects a larger space

branch_SLOT_search_space.description: Optional init-file search override; otherwise Bundle writes Core-derived editable lists into this branch. Edit its generated search_space or clear it to {} for automatic resolution.

branch_SLOT_regression_search_metric.description: Branch SLOT | Objective for choosing regression parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_SLOT_classification_search_metric.description: Branch SLOT | Objective for choosing classification parameters on training folds; separate from the heldout lifecycle metric

branch_SLOT_search_n_trials.description: Branch SLOT | Trials or initial sampled candidates for random, halving_random and Optuna (1-1000)

branch_SLOT_search_timeout.description: Branch SLOT | Optional Optuna soft stop in positive seconds; null disables it. A running estimator fit is not interrupted

branch_SLOT_search_random_state.description: Branch SLOT | Seed for sampled parameter choices, separate from the heldout split seed and CV fold seed

branch_SLOT_search_factor.description: Branch SLOT | Successive halving keeps roughly one in this many candidates per round (integer 2 or more)

branch_SLOT_search_resource.description: Branch SLOT | Halving budget resource: training rows or estimator n_estimators. n_estimators requires explicit max_resources and a compatible model

branch_SLOT_search_min_resources.description: Branch SLOT | Halving starting budget: exhaust, smallest, or a positive integer

branch_SLOT_search_estimator_min_resourc.description: Branch SLOT | Starting estimator budget for n_estimators halving (integer 2 or more; must not exceed max_resources)

branch_SLOT_search_max_resources.description: Branch SLOT | Maximum estimator resource count for n_estimators halving; enter a positive integer compatible with the selected model

branch_SLOT_search_sampler.description: Branch SLOT | Optuna sampler: TPE, random or CMA-ES; CMA-ES samples categorical axes randomly

branch_SLOT_search_pruner.description: Branch SLOT | Optuna trial pruner; Core checks whether the selected model and validation method support early stopping. none disables pruning

branch_SLOT_search_pruning.description: Branch SLOT | Allow Optuna pruning when model and validation settings support it

branch_SLOT_search_tune_threshold.description: Branch SLOT | Select a binary decision threshold from inner out-of-fold predictions. Requires probability output; final holdout stays untouched.

branch_SLOT_regression_metric.description: Branch SLOT | Metric for comparing regression models on separate test data (heldout). Lower error is better; higher R2 or explained variance is better

branch_SLOT_classification_metric.description: Branch SLOT | Metric for comparing classification models on separate test data (heldout). Some metrics need probabilities or specific class counts

branch_SLOT_min_improvement.description: Branch SLOT | Minimum metric improvement required for manual or automatic promotion; ties never pass

branch_SLOT_quality_threshold.description: Branch SLOT | Absolute quality gate; numeric required for automatic promotion or manual first-champion approval. Choose for your metric and task.

branch_SLOT_quality_gates.description: Branch SLOT | Optional init-file JSON object of additional heldout metric thresholds, or null

branch_SLOT_lookback_days.description: Branch SLOT | Total elapsed 24-hour days before each run to read, including holdout; enter 1 to 36500

branch_SLOT_holdout_days.description: Branch SLOT | Final elapsed days reserved for temporal testing; enter 1 to lookback_days minus 1
